footer.privacy: No data is sent to or stored on our server through this website.
index.intro: This page helps general practitioners and other physicians request a polygraphy (PG) or polysomnography (PSG) at the Sleep Clinic quickly. You fill in a structured referral letter, turn it into a PDF in your browser, and book the appointment yourself in Nexuzhealth Consult.
index.stap1: Choose the study: polygraphy or polysomnography (or let the sleep physician decide).
index.stap2: Fill in the referral letter and download the PDF — everything stays in your browser.
index.stap3: Book the appointment in Nexuzhealth Consult and attach the PDF.
index.pg_tekst: Home recording of breathing, oxygen saturation, heart rate and body position, without EEG. Suitable when the pre-test probability of uncomplicated obstructive sleep apnoea is high: loud snoring, witnessed apnoeas, daytime sleepiness, high STOP-BANG score.
index.psg_tekst: Full recording in the sleep laboratory, with EEG, sleep stages, arousals and leg movements. Indicated when the pre-test probability is lower, when there is relevant comorbidity (heart failure, stroke, COPD, neuromuscular disease, opioids) or when another sleep disorder is suspected.
index.keuzehulp_noot: The decision aid on the form suggests a study type based on the STOP-BANG score and comorbidity. The sleep physician reviews every request and may change the type of study.
aanvraag.intro: Fill in the fields and click “Create referral letter (PDF)” at the bottom. The PDF is generated in your browser; nothing is sent to our server.
aanvraag.patient_rrn_hint: In Consult you look up the patient by national register number.
aanvraag.urgentie_verhoogd: Increased (professional driver, recent accident, pregnancy, pre-operative)
aanvraag.ess_intro: How likely is the patient to doze off or fall asleep in the following situations? 0 = never, 1 = slight chance, 2 = moderate chance, 3 = high chance.
aanvraag.ess_3: Sitting inactive in a public place (theatre, meeting)
aanvraag.ess_4: As a passenger in a car for an hour without a break
aanvraag.ess_5: Lying down to rest in the afternoon when circumstances permit
aanvraag.ess_7: Sitting quietly after a lunch without alcohol
aanvraag.ess_8: In a car, while stopped for a few minutes in traffic
aanvraag.stopbang_intro: One point per yes. The items BMI, age, neck circumference and sex are derived from the data above, but you can override them.
aanvraag.sb_t: T — Tired or sleepy during the day
aanvraag.keuzehulp_arts: The sleep physician reviews every request and may change the type of study.
aanvraag.volgende_tekst: Attach this PDF to your appointment in Nexuzhealth Consult.
consult.titel: Book an appointment in Nexuzhealth Consult
consult.intro: Nexuzhealth Consult is nexuzhealth's free portal for external healthcare providers. You log in with itsme or eID, look up the patient, choose the department and a time slot, and attach the referral letter. The appointment then goes straight into the Sleep Clinic's schedule.
consult.knop_deeplink: Straight to the Sleep Clinic in Consult
consult.stap1: Log in with itsme or eID.
consult.stap2: Look up the patient (by national register number).
consult.stap4: Choose the hospital → department “{dienst}” (polygraphy or polysomnography, site of your choice).
consult.stap4_zonder_dienst: Choose the hospital → Sleep Clinic department (polygraphy or polysomnography, site of your choice).
consult.stap6: Fill in the indication and attach the referral letter (PDF).
consult.stap7: Confirm the appointment. The patient receives the confirmation from the hospital.
consult.terugval_tekst: Call the Sleep Clinic secretariat or send the referral letter via eHealthBox.
consult.geen_patientdata: Never send patient data by ordinary e-mail.
